candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey shake for body now. E never get convulsion before. Pikin dey alert, e no weak or dey unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything wey e chop. Fever don dey for two days. E no get rash for body. Dem no identify bacterial cause for this assessment. Malaria test dey available. Malaria test show negative. E no dey cough for measles. E never get measles for the past three months. E no get any clear reason for the fever. E eye no red. E no get catarrh. E neck no stiff. E temperature na 38.0°C. Pikin na 18 months old. E no cough or get wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E ear dey ok, e no get ear problem. E get fever.
